question: A pair of tangents drawn from point from C and touches the circle (with center O) at B and D. If the ∠BCD is 60∘ then find the angle between the two chords AB and AD (point A is at major sector of the circle).
solution:
**Given:**

A pair of tangents are drawn from the point from C and touches the circle (with centre O) at B and D. 

The ∠BCD is 60∘.

**Concept used:**

The angle between the tangent and radius is always 90∘.

The sum of opposite angles in a cyclic quadrilateral is 180∘.

The sum of all interior angles for the quadrilateral is 360∘.

The angle subtended by an arc at the centre is twice that of the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circumference of the circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f04fc60c09ba3b5d8760bdc57e570c261efee9d93829cd28747192128ee0d156.png] 

**Calculation:**

According to the question, the required figure is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc5e808c312bdd4aa5721418cf0cf284616d15369ba46d96b78d50d82f7eaa53.png] 

Since The angle between the tangent and radius is always 90∘.

Therefore,

∠OBC = ∠ODC = 90∘

In quadrilateral OBCD.

⇒ ∠BOD + ∠OBC + ∠BCD + ∠ODC = 360∘

⇒ ∠BOD + 90∘ + 60∘ + 90∘ = 360∘

⇒ ∠BOD + 240∘ = 360∘

⇒ ∠BOD = 120∘

Since the angle subtended by an arc at the centre is twice that of the angle subtended by it at any point on the remaining part of the circumference of the circle,

Therefore,

⇒ ∠BOD = 2∠BAD

⇒ 2∠BAD = 120∘

⇒ ∠BAD = 60∘

**∴ The value of the required angle is 60∘**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ce59a5dea46d8ba0c5fba78f3eccdc38ae24ed3d4a2733fbb70b90cfd6636f.png] 

Point Y is at Major sector of the circle.

Point X is at Minor sector of the circle.
